name: search
description: A clear circular search lens with a short angled handle.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested boxed Filled Search replaces the earlier Outline-only direction. It follows the accepted Plus/X shared-glyph construction: both magnifiers have visible bounds 4..20, identical position and Regular-equivalent 1.70 stroke with .85 round caps. The lens center is 10.35632184,10.35632184 with centerline radius 5.50632184; the handle starts on the lens circle at 45 degrees and ends at 19.15,19.15. Centerline geometry is resized about 12,12 while stroke weight stays fixed. The upright Filled box spans 2..22 with radius-4 corners, leaving 2px outside the box and 2px to the shared glyph. Its evenodd compound path contains the box, the exact union of the lens exterior and rounded handle, then the inner lens circle. This makes the magnifier stroke negative space while preserving the solid center inside the lens. No overlapping cutouts or doubled seams. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Both revised styles were owner-approved on 2026-10-27.

review.note: Owner approved both revised Outline and boxed Filled Search, including the shared bounds 4..20, radius-4 box at 2..22, 2px clearances and unchanged Regular 1.70 weight.
